question.text: The purpose of representations and warranties in an SPA is to:

answer.text: Guarantee future profitability of the investee company
Provide factual statements about the company's condition that form the basis for the investment decision
Transfer management control to the AIF
Set the dividend policy for the next five years

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook (pp.145-147) describes the due-diligence report (DDR) as examining the facts, representations, and affairs of the investee in order to inform the investment decision. DDR findings are then used to strengthen the representations and warranties given by the seller/company in the definitive agreements, so that the AIF's investment decision rests on a clear, documented factual baseline of the company's condition at the time of investment. The Trap: Representations and warranties do not guarantee future profitability, do not by themselves transfer management control, and do not fix the company's dividend policy for any future period. Note: Source reference: NISM Series XIX-A workbook pp.145-147 (DDR — facts, representations and affairs; representations and warranties in definitive agreements).
